_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · consensus（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（elicit/notebooklm/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [elicit, notebooklm, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Scientific-literature retrieval engine + conclusion extraction: a self-built paper index (200M+ papers narrative, official-site framing — not verified item by item) + Consensus Meter (polarity statistics across multiple studies' conclusions, the product's signature).
axes.runtime: Web (consensus.app) as the main entry; literature retrieval and conclusion generation both happen on the vendor's cloud; no officially stated local form seen.
axes.local_files: Search history and highlight annotations are stored on the account-side cloud; PDF/citation exports count as local. No other local data surfaces officially stated seen.
axes.background: Retrieval and Meter statistics return instantly; no official task queue or "keep-running-after-shutdown" style background task surface seen (not verified item by item).
axes.tools: **Consensus Meter is the signature**: a statistical summary of "which way science leans on X" (support/oppose/mixed counts); filtering by study type/sample size; AI synthesized answers with citations; PDF highlight Q&A (Pro line, official product surface).
axes.context: Research projects organized via search history and folders; cross-session memory and user profiling not verified to an official statement (not verified item by item).
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: pricing not collected); free-tier feature limits not verified item by item; the training-use switch not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: "what does science say" questions (medicine/nutrition/climate and other empirical fields), quick polarity calls, literature triage. Does not fit: deep systematic reviews (its extraction surface is lighter than Elicit's), Chinese-literature-first, treating the Meter as settled science.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **How the Meter's polarity stats on contested topics deviate from human reviews**
- **How the statistics shift after filtering by sample size/study type**
- **The feature boundary between the free tier and Pro**
unknowns:

- ToS details (CF 403 blocked direct fetch)

related: Also scientific-literature oriented: Consensus gives quick polarity reads, Elicit does deep extraction for reviews.
Complementary: Consensus finds literature and gives polarity, NotebookLM digs deep inside the sources you pick.
Chinese academic counterpart: Metaso's academic tier searches Chinese libraries, Consensus works the English empirical pool.
